## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the optimization, governor, driver, or feature you are proposing.

## 🎯 Motivation & Value
Why should this be added to ZeroByte Kernel? How does it benefit battery longevity, thermal performance, or system responsiveness?

## 🔍 Technical Details & References
If available, provide links to commits, documentation, or upstream Linux/AOSP patches.
- Patch / Commit URL:
- Affected subsystem (e.g., `sched`, `power`, `mm`, `net`):

## ⚠️ ABI / KMI Impact
Will this feature modify core struct layouts (e.g., `task_struct`) or break compatibility with OEM Wi-Fi / Audio DLKM modules?
- [ ] No impact on KMI / GKI 2.0 ABI
- [ ] Unknown / Needs testing
